tools.name: list_characters
tools.title: List characters
tools.description: List the signed-in player's Thornvale characters with level, class, race and highest tower floor.

tools.name: get_character
tools.title: Get character
tools.description: Show a character's level, class, health, gold, location, combat stats, top skills and affinities.

character.description: Character slot number from list_characters (1-5). Omit to use the character currently being played.

tools.name: get_equipment
tools.title: Get equipment
tools.description: Show a character's equipped gear in every slot (grade, element, enhancement, durability and stats), plus ranged or torch off-hand.

character.description: Character slot number from list_characters (1-5). Omit to use the character currently being played.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.title: Get inventory
tools.description: List a character's materials, home storage, food, Craftery items and unequipped gear.

character.description: Character slot number from list_characters (1-5). Omit to use the character currently being played.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.title: Get progress
tools.description: Show a character's tower progress, magic schools and spells, village building and gathering spot levels, companions, titles and achievements.

character.description: Character slot number from list_characters (1-5). Omit to use the character currently being played.
